name: verifica
description: KYC and AML compliance for regulated businesses. Open a KYC case for an individual or company and send your client a link to complete the KYC form and upload supporting documents. Each submission is screened against World-Check, and your compliance team resolves matches, assesses risk and signs off the case in Verifica. Requires a Verifica account.

interface.shortDescription: Open client KYC and AML checks
interface.longDescription: KYC and AML compliance for regulated businesses. Open a KYC case for an individual or company and send your client a link to complete the KYC form and upload supporting documents. Each submission is screened against World-Check, and your compliance team resolves matches, assesses risk and signs off the case in Verifica. Requires a Verifica account.
defaultPrompt: Help me to do KYC for my client

publication.release_notes: Initial Verifica MCP plugin submission. Verifica is the new name of our published VeriKYC app, which this plugin replaces.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, initiate payments, or promote upgrades. World-Check screening after a client submits uses the organization's existing Verifica KYC balance.

positive.description: Check the signed-in account and organization.
positive.prompt: Show me info about my workspace
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the user's name, email, and current organization.

positive.description: Use a review account that belongs to an organization named Verifica MCP second organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms Verifica MCP second organization as the default organization; an unmatched or ambiguous name makes no change.

positive.description: Ask for missing required fields before creating a link.
positive.prompt: Create a KYC form link for my individual client
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the purpose and any other missing required fields in one message, without guessing or creating a case; offers the reusable link if available.

positive.description: Ask to create Verifica case, providing necessary data for assistant to create form without asking more data.
positive.prompt: Create a KYC form link for Northwind Labs Ltd, a company, for Onboarding, investment: 5000 eur, use English.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one case and returns the client form link, case link and next steps; client documents and screening results stay in Verifica.

positive.description: Continue the previous test to send the existing link.
positive.prompt: Send the KYC form link we just created to this email: <receiver email>.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends one invitation for the existing link and confirms the recipient, without creating another case.

negative.description: General information does not need account access. Expected: Explains the terms without invoking Verifica.
negative.prompt: Explain KYC and AML in plain English without accessing my account.

negative.description: Screening review is handled in the Verifica app. Expected: Directs the user to review the case in Verifica without invoking tools or claiming to resolve matches.
negative.prompt: Show my client's World-Check matches and mark them as false positives.

negative.description: Edit an existing case. Expected: Does not invoke Verifica because its tools cannot generate property reports.
negative.prompt: Show me the documents my client uploaded to their completed KYC form.
